stages.text: introduction text: what taking part involves

stages.title: introduction screen title; draft: "Naming persons"
stages.text: introduction screen text: what the next screen asks the participant to do, and how
stages.draft: On the next screen you will be asked a question. Add each person who comes to mind, answer a few short questions about them, and save. Move on when you have added everyone.

stages.title: introduction screen title; draft: "Sorting the persons you named"
stages.text: introduction screen text: what the next screen asks the participant to do, and how
stages.draft: On the next screen you will see the persons you named and a set of boxes. Drag each person into the box that describes them best.

stages.title: introduction screen title; draft: "Your network map"
stages.text: introduction screen text: what the next screen asks the participant to do, and how
stages.draft:
On the next screen you will see the persons you named on a map, with you at the centre.

Tap each person the question describes. Tap them again to undo.

questions.draft: Do you agree to take part in this study?
What is the name of this person?
